note: Config Distro is an event-driven framework for applying a distribution's config updates. Core piece: the config_distro.storage.distro service (a ManagedStorage backed by DistroStorageManager) - reading it copies active config to a MemoryStorage, dispatches ConfigDistroEvents::TRANSFORM (config_distro.transform) so subscribers rewrite it, and returns a ReadOnlyStorage; on a clean site (no companion like config_sync) it mirrors active config. ConfigDistroEvents::IMPORT (config_distro.import) fires after an import. UI: route config_distro.import at /admin/config/development/distro (the module's configure route), ConfigDistroImportForm (extends core ConfigSync), permission 'synchronize distro configuration'. Drush: config-distro-update (alias cd-update, --preview=list|diff). Requires config_filter. Submodules: config_distro_filter (deprecated bridge), config_distro_ignore. No config entity/schema of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the live config_distro.storage.distro service (which reliably reflects active config) and the live config_filter plugin registry; hard cases store results in Drupal State, verified live. (Note: the global distro-vs-active changelist is not asserted, as it depends on which other config_filter modules are enabled on this shared site.)

evals.prompt: What Drush command does the config_distro module add to apply configuration updates from a distribution, and what is its alias?
evals.expected_output: drush config-distro-update (alias cd-update). It compares the distribution storage against active config and, after a preview (--preview=list or diff), imports the changes.

evals.prompt: config_distro is an event-driven framework. What are the two events it defines, and when does each fire?
evals.expected_output: ConfigDistroEvents::TRANSFORM ('config_distro.transform') fires each time the distro storage is built, letting subscribers rewrite it to the distribution's desired state; ConfigDistroEvents::IMPORT ('config_distro.import') fires after a distribution import completes.

evals.prompt: Where is the config_distro distribution-update UI, and which permission controls access to it?
evals.expected_output: The import UI is at /admin/config/development/distro (route config_distro.import, the module's configure route, rendered by ConfigDistroImportForm). It and the diff pages require the 'synchronize distro configuration' permission.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a configuration object 'config_distro_eval.data' in its active configuration. Using config_distro's distribution storage service, read that object and report the value of its 'color' key.
evals.expected_output: Read it through \Drupal::service('config_distro.storage.distro')->read('config_distro_eval.data'); since no transform subscriber changes it, the distro storage mirrors active config, so color is teal.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the registered Config Filter plugins and identify which one is bound to the config_distro distribution storage (config_distro.storage.distro).
evals.expected_output: The config_distro_ignore filter plugin declares storages = {config_distro.storage.distro} in its @ConfigFilter annotation, so it is the plugin bound to the distro storage (config_merge, by contrast, is bound to config.storage.sync).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a config object 'config_distro_eval.readh' in active configuration. Using config_distro's distribution storage service, read that config object as the distribution storage sees it and store the resulting value (the array) into Drupal State under the key 'config_distro_eval_read'. Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: \Drupal::state()->set('config_distro_eval_read', \Drupal::service('config_distro.storage.distro')->read('config_distro_eval.readh')); — the stored array must contain marker => DISTRO123.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use config_distro's distribution storage service to read the config object 'config_distro_eval.cmph' as the distribution sees it, compare it to the same object in the active configuration storage, and store the string "MATCH" into Drupal State key 'config_distro_eval_match' if they are identical (or "DIFF" if they differ). Apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: $d = \Drupal::service('config_distro.storage.distro')->read('config_distro_eval.cmph'); $a = \Drupal::service('config.storage')->read('config_distro_eval.cmph'); \Drupal::state()->set('config_distro_eval_match', $d === $a ? 'MATCH' : 'DIFF'); — because no transform subscriber changes this item, the distro copy equals the active copy, so the stored value is MATCH.
